### Key Steps to Support Your Claim

1. **Seek medical attention:** Ensure your injuries are properly diagnosed and documented by a doctor.
2. **Report the incident:** Notify the shopping centre management or centre security immediately and request an incident report copy.
3. **Preserve evidence:** Take photos of the hazard (e.g., the spill or unsafe flooring) and get contact details from any witnesses.[[1]](https://www.blumers.com.au/canberra/slip-and-fall-lawyers/)

If you can share **when the fall happened** and **what kind of injury** you sustained, I can help outline the specific time limits and compensation categories that may apply to your case.
